name: Context
sourceRefs: PyX12 (azoner/pyx12) 999.5010X231.A1.xml. IMPORTANT: this IG map declares CTX at THREE distinct positions — 2100's 'Segment Context' (max_use 9), 2100's own second, separate 'Business Unit Identifier' occurrence (max_use 1), and 2110's 'Element Context' (max_use 10) — each with different PER-ELEMENT usage/situational constraints (e.g. CTX02/03/04/06 are required in the first and third but explicitly Not-Used in the second, which instead requires CTX01-02). This schema's shared-segment-library architecture has one CTX definition for every position that references it (edi/loop_engine.go resolves segments purely by ID, with no per-loop-position variant mechanism) — so this file is the PERMISSIVE UNION of all 3 real variants: every element genuinely used (R or S) in at least one of the 3 is kept as situational, and CTX06-02 (the one sub-position marked Not-Used in literally all 3 variants) is the only position dropped entirely, matching CLP.json's own established 'omit N positions entirely' precedent. Position-specific tightening (e.g. rejecting a stray CTX01-02 value on a 'Segment Context' occurrence) is out of scope, consistent with this project's own 'flexible, not rigid' validator design (see edi/validator's SyntaxRule doc comment) — genuinely malformed VALUES still fail Validate, only this cross-position ambiguity is left permissive. maxUse is set to '>1' since a single 2100 loop instance can carry both the up-to-9-repeat 'Segment Context' variant AND the single 'Business Unit Identifier' occurrence back to back — this engine's own MaxUse is a binary '1'/'>1' flag with no numeric ceiling modeled anywhere else in the schema either.
